answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the inlet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the harbor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
